title: Bernasconi 2018 trunk PPS with intracranial EEG
citation: Bernasconi, F., Noel, J.-P., Park, H. D., Faivre, N., Seeck, M., Spinelli, L., Schaller, K., Blanke, O., & Serino, A. (2018). Audio-Tactile and Peripersonal Space Processing Around the Trunk in Human Parietal and Temporal Cortex: An Intracranial EEG Study. Cerebral Cortex, 28(9), 3385–3397.
variant_display: Bernasconi 2018 trunk PPS with intracranial EEG

blocking_reasons.reason: A clinical iEEG analysis path requires electrode-specific preprocessing, event-aligned local field potentials, referenced contact masks and the two published integration and PPS analysis paths. The exact masks, remaining supplementary implantation table and original analysis code are unavailable.
The trial scheduler must intermix A, T and AT and deliver three separately timed sternum pulses within each T and AT trial. The sound and pulse timing require a common clock.
Exact source audio, original delivery gains and acoustic calibration, tactile acceleration calibration, hardware latencies and trigger encodings are unavailable.
The clinical acquisition scheduler must synchronize ExpyVR and Arduino stimulus events to the Micromed iEEG recording and preserve passive observation without behavioral scoring.
Exact pulse-jitter allocation, original trial and interval sequence, block structure and alignment of auditory-only epochs to the corresponding tactile events are unreported or unavailable.
